enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running to stay cool through the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket over body. Fan oscillates. Turn head to left. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Extend arm. Fan continues. Pull blanket up. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a cool shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up and sit up. Stand up and walk to bathroom. Turn on light and tap. Wash face and brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn on shower and adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, toasting bread and eating breakfast while checking the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle and turn on. Open fridge and take out bread and butter. Place bread in toaster and press lever. Take out plate and knife. Kettle boils. Turn off kettle. Pour water into cup. Add tea bag and stir. Toaster pops. Take out toast and butter it. Sit at table. Pick up phone and unlock. Check messages. Eat toast and drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes, packing bag and collecting personal items
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt, pants, socks, shoes. Open bag. Place stethoscope, wallet, keys in bag. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Close bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health care facility on a hot morning
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Wipe sweat with tissue. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to facility. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and completing clinical documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Greet patient. Check patient vitals. Listen to heart. Measure blood pressure. Update chart. Walk to next patient. Repeat. Take notes. Use computer. Type notes. Answer phone. Consult with colleague. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and rehydrating at the facility
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to break room. Open fridge. Take out lunch box. Open lunch box. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Refill water bottle. Wipe mouth. Throw away trash. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing patient care, medication rounds and handover preparation
enriched_activities.desc: Check medication cart. Prepare medications. Walk to patient room. Administer medication. Check patient response. Document. Walk to next patient. Repeat. Prepare handover notes. Print handover. Attend handover meeting. Discuss cases.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home during the hottest part of the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Wipe sweat. Drink water. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Open door. Close door. Take off shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a light dinner with the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and changing into light home clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Put on home clothes. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with the fan and TV, using the computer, keeping air-conditioner use low during the evening peak tax
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on fan. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Check email. Browse internet. Turn off TV. Turn on computer. Use computer. Turn on desk lamp. Adjust fan speed.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, using the phone and turning on the bedroom fan before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Turn on fan. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through social media. Check messages. Set alarm. Turn off phone. Take off glasses. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping ahead of the next workday
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down. Close eyes. Fan runs. Turn head. Adjust pillow. Turn body. Bend knees. Extend arm. Pull blanket. Fan oscillates. Shift legs. Sleep.
